dataset_name: Grupo Lar - Transferencias internas de recursos
business_domain: Construcción - logística interna de materiales entre almacenes y obras
grain: One row represents one line of an internal resource transfer inside a transfer voucher (num_comprobante). A voucher can contain several lines (several resources).
known_business_notes: monto_debe is the value of the transferred resources; monto_haber is the reversed amount (returns or cancellations).
monto_total is a calculated field: monto_debe - monto_haber. It is not stored in the fact table.
cantidad_recursos is expressed in the unit of measure of each resource (bags, m3, kg, gallons, units...).
Each transfer has two locations: sede_origen (sends) and sede_destino (receives). Both come from the same dimension (role-playing dimension).
Currency is Peruvian soles (PEN). Data covers January to December 2025.
The chart of accounts is real (CONCAR); transfers, resources and locations are simulated for academic purposes.
